The '''mother''' of [[Jaalib Brandl]] was a resident of [[Kovit]] on [[Trulalis]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]]. In [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]], after Jaalib's father, [[Adalric Cessius Brandl]] had visited the planet while on the run from [[High Inquisitor]] [[Antinnis Tremayne]], Jaalib's mother was killed defending her son from a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] raid.
